# CoreBolt — Full Site Content Index

> Detailed reference for AI systems and crawlers. CoreBolt (core-bolt.com) is a Hyderabad, India-based
> supplier of industrial sensing, edge-compute hardware, and motion/connectivity components for robotics,
> automation, and AI applications.

---

## Product Categories

### LiDAR Sensors
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/lidar
CoreBolt provides 3D LiDAR sensors from Livox, Hesai, RoboSense, Ouster, Velodyne, and SICK for robotics, industrial automation, autonomous vehicles, drones, intelligent transportation, and smart infrastructure. Brand lines include Ouster & Velodyne, Hesai, Livox, RoboSense, and SICK, covering mechanical and solid-state 3D LiDAR for AMRs, AGVs, and autonomous navigation.

### Edge Computers
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/edge-computers
CoreBolt Edge Computers deliver scalable edge computing for AI, machine vision, robotics, automation, and Industrial IoT, powered by NVIDIA Jetson and Intel architectures. Product lines include the HyperEdge and HyperCore series for real-time processing in demanding environments.

### Industrial Panel Computers
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/industrial-panel-pc
Rugged, fanless industrial touch panel PCs (HyperCore IPC S, G, and T series) combining industrial-grade computing with touchscreen interfaces for HMI, machine control, process visualization, and factory automation. Built for 24/7 operation in manufacturing, warehousing, and Industry 4.0 environments.

### Vision Systems & Cameras
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/vision-systems-cameras
Industrial cameras, stereo depth cameras, and GMSL cameras for automation, robotics, and AI applications, designed for integration with NVIDIA Jetson and Intel-based edge platforms. Includes the Sensing Cameras subcategory (GMSL, GMSL2, TI FPD-Link III, MIPI CSI-2, GigE) plus ZED and Intel RealSense stereo depth cameras, used for quality inspection, object detection, autonomous navigation, and SLAM.

### Motion Control & Connectivity (blog-documented, catalog listing in progress)
CoreBolt also supplies linear actuators, custom servo lift columns, and wiring harness & connector solutions for industrial automation, robotics, and OEM/ODM applications. These are currently documented on the blog; dedicated catalog pages are not yet live.

### Perception Kits
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/perception-kits
Integrated perception kits pairing edge compute with sensing hardware for robotics and automation development.

### Complete Guide to Edge AI, GPU Computing & NVIDIA Jetson
URL: https://www.core-bolt.com/blog/ai-edge-comuter-complete-guide-to-edge-ai-gpu-computing-nvidia-jetson
AI Edge Computers are specialized computing systems that process artificial intelligence workloads locally, near the source of data generation. Instead of sending data to remote cloud servers, they perform AI inference directly on devices such as cameras, sensors, robots, and industrial equipment. This enables real-time decision-making, reduces latency, improves data security, and supports intelligent automation across industries.
